Journal Article · Advanced Healthcare Materials 13 (11), 2303309, 2024

NADPH oxidase‐like nanozyme for high‐efficiency tumor therapy through increasing glutathione consumption and blocking glutathione regeneration

D Han, B Ding, P Zheng, M Yuan, Y Bian, H Chen, M Wang, M Chang, ...

Paper

Abstract

To counteract the high level of reactive oxygen species (ROS) caused by rapid growth, tumor cells resist oxidative stress by accelerating the production and regeneration of intracellular glutathione (GSH). Numerous studies focus on the consumption of GSH, but the regeneration of GSH will enhance the reduction level of tumor cells to resist oxidative stress. Therefore, inhibiting the regeneration of GSH; while, consuming GSH is of great significance for breaking the redox balance of tumor cells. Herein, a simple termed MnOx‐coated Au (AMO) nanoflower, as a nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH) oxidase (NOX) nanoenzyme, is reported for efficient tumor therapy. Au nanoparticles exhibit the capability to catalyze the oxidation of NADPH, hindering GSH regeneration; while, concurrently functioning as a photothermal agent.
